'''Cave swallows''' are a species of unremarkable [[vermin]] which can be encountered in [[caverns]]. They can be captured by [[trapper]]s and turned into low-value [[pet]]s.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] cave swallows for their ''coloration''.

[[File:Vermin-CaveSwallow.jpg|thumb|center|Admired for its ''coloration''.]]

{{Translation| dwarven = äs mozib | elvish = garetho thicera | goblin = omo nabok | human = ngethac cocu}}

{{D for Dwarf}}
<!-- Reference: Monty Python and the Holy Grail -->
[[Monarch|Kings]] are required to know much about swallows. Certain swallows may be capable of carrying [[Coconut palm|coconuts]] to [[Temperate|temperate zones]]; however, they have never been observed doing so, being non-migratory.
